comparisons.method: difference of medians of run-level statistics; 95% percentile-bootstrap CI over runs (B=2000, seeded)

notes: latency = scheduled send time -> response, measured inside the Compose network (open-loop)
percentiles are type-7 linear interpolation; p90/p95/p99 need n >= 100/200/1000 per run
per-run percentiles are never averaged; pooled values are labelled POOLED
success = confirmed or rejected; availability additionally counts degraded
recovery_s is measured from fault end (actual injection time + duration) with the rolling window and hold time given per fault
simulated environments are labels on one Docker host, not cloud deployments
